name: Prafulla Chandra Ghosh
role: First Chief Minister of West Bengal
contribution: Ghosh became the first Chief Minister of West Bengal after the province was divided in 1947.
context: His administration faced the immediate work of establishing institutions for the new Indian province while partition displaced communities and disrupted Bengal’s economic and administrative networks.
impact: His short first ministry marked the transition from united provincial governance to the post-partition state of West Bengal.

faq.answer: Prafulla Chandra Ghosh is connected to the partition era as First Chief Minister of West Bengal. He led the first provincial government of West Bengal after partition.
